main_failure_modes: Halo effect was used as a near-neighbor label instead of the hidden Authority Bias target, despite a full mechanism and location match.
The hidden Optimism bias occurrence was replaced by an availability-heuristic interpretation of the same occupancy evidence.
The moderate-confidence ambiguity finding is missed at the high-only threshold.
main_strengths: Correctly identifies clustering illusion, hindsight bias, and base-rate neglect with valid evidence and full mechanisms.
Correctly identifies the ambiguity mechanism using an approved equivalent label when moderate findings are included.
Maintains valid quotations and accurately discloses that no retrieved corpus support was used.
Produces perfect segment-level detection at the recommended threshold without negative-segment false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run has strong localization and mechanism coverage but imperfect taxonomy fidelity. The gap between strict and mechanism-first scores is driven mainly by the halo-effect/Authority-Bias near-neighbor distinction and the availability-versus-optimism substitution; the run should not be treated as complete six-instance identification under the strict scorecard.
